title: Stan Meyer water dissociation and zero point energy

tellings.quote: So this man Stan Meyer observed an effect that at certain frequencies water would dissociate into hydrogen and oxygen at less than the Faraday constant.

plain: An inventor named Stan Meyer found that at certain frequencies water would split into hydrogen and oxygen using less electricity than standard chemistry, set by a value called the Faraday constant, says is needed. Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, tells this and ties it to zero point energy, the idea of drawing power from empty space, crediting a book called The Lost Century. If true, it would mean cheap fuel from water had been found.
